title: Neuroradiolological Analysis of COVID-19 Patients
brief_summary: To describe the radiological presentation of brain abnormalities in COVID-19 + patients
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults
* COVID-19 +
* Abnormal neurological examination
* who underwent a brain MRI

Exclusion Criteria:

* No participation agreement
* Non COVID-19 patients
* Patients COVID-19 + without neurological abnormality or without MRI examination
study_population: Patients COVID-19 with abnormal neurological examination
